title: Cliffside Marina & Yacht Club
specs: Located in Prince William Sound, popular marina with multiple slip sizes
Minimum $300,000 vessel insurance coverage required with Protection and Indemnity Certificate naming marina as additional insured
gap: Slip availability not stated online; must call for current vacancies
blurb: Cliffside Marina provides boat slips for rent in Prince William Sound with various slip sizes available. The marina enforces pollution prevention practices and vessel insurance requirements. It offers parking facilities and guidance on weather preparedness, especially for katabatic winds.
extraNote: No transfer of fuel from portable containers to fixed tanks; fueling only at Fuel Dock · All vessels must be secured with adequate lines during storms; follow weather preparedness guidelines for katabatic winds · Parking requires current year Owner Parking Pass or $20 flat-rate 24 hour fee; oversized vehicles not permitted in main lot · Owners responsible for cleanup and restoration if vessel sinks or releases pollutants
